battle.name: 第十次敘利亞戰役
battle.theater: 敘利亞北部貝利赫河谷
battle.brief: 圖特摩斯三世第二十二年（約公元前一四四四年）發動的第十次敘利亞遠征，兵鋒深入幼發拉底河中游，攻取圖尼普，與受米坦尼影響的北敘利亞聯盟交戰。卡爾納克與拉美西姆的戰役表均記此役。此役埃及步兵以長矛為主要刺擊兵器，密集矛陣配合弓箭手掩護，長矛兵攀梯破城。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 本役是第十八王朝新王國與北敘利亞聯盟之間的一場戰役，交手地點在幼發拉底河中游的敘利亞北部高原。埃及方面由法老圖特摩斯三世親任全軍最高統帥，軍隊以神名編為師團，見於阿蒙師、賴師、塞特師、荷魯斯師與蒙圖師，各師團各有旗幟、師長與下屬的中隊長；法老身邊有維齊爾隨軍處理民政與軍需，另有軍務官逐日記錄行軍與戰果。迦南一線由埃及任命的居民長與關塞守將管治，加薩、耶路撒冷與佩爾-傑德哈塞等據點構成本次遠征的後方與補給樞紐。埃及步兵以持矛兵與弓箭手為主，另有努比亞弓手、由沙漠部族編成的梅傑伊輕步兵，以及新近投效的舍爾登傭兵充當王室衝鋒與貼身衛隊。北方聯軍則由城邦小王組成，包括圖尼普、卡疊施、阿勒頗、哈馬圖與卡爾基米什等地的諸王，其中多數受上美索不達米亞的胡里王國米坦尼支配；聯軍以步兵與弓手為骨幹，車兵稀少，攻城器械近乎空白，難以應付有備而來的埃及大軍。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Egyptian Empire of the Eighteenth Dynasty and a coalition of northern Syrian city-states, the fighting taking place on the Syrian uplands of the middle Euphrates. On the Egyptian side the pharaoh Thutmose III held supreme command in person, and the army was organised into divisions named after gods — the Division of Amun, of Re, of Seth, of Horus and of Montu — each with its own standard, its own commander and its own sub-units. A vizier accompanied the king to handle administration and supply, while army scribes recorded each day's marches and each day's results. The line in Canaan was governed by Egyptian Residents and fortress commandants, and the posts at Gaza, Jerusalem and Per-Djedkhase formed the rear base and the supply hinge of this expedition. The Egyptian infantry was built on spearmen and archers, supplemented by Nubian archers, Medjay light infantry drawn from the desert tribes, and newly hired Sherden mercenaries who served as the pharaoh's shock troops and personal guard. The northern coalition, by contrast, was a league of petty city-state kings — the rulers of Tunip, Kadesh, Aleppo, Hamath and Carchemish — most of them clients of the Hurrian kingdom of Mitanni in Upper Mesopotamia. Their army rested on infantry and archers, had few chariots and almost no siege equipment, and was therefore poorly placed to meet a prepared Egyptian host.
people: 圖特摩斯三世是整場戰爭的關鍵人物。他的王名含「強力的公牛」之義，登基之後十數年反覆遠征黎凡特，第十次敘利亞遠征發生在他統治的第二十二年；本役的勝利、圖尼普陷落與城中被劫掠的景象，都被刻在卡爾納克阿蒙神廟的浮雕上。隨軍者包括掌民政與軍需的維齊爾、逐日抄錄軍令的軍務官，以及阿蒙神廟主持祭祀與祝禱的祭司團；立於陣前的則是率領王室突擊的舍爾登傭兵首領與「勇兵」之首。北方方面，圖尼普的守王在城破之日被俘，卡疊施與哈馬圖諸王各自引兵來援又各自潰散，米坦尼大王圖什拉塔的使者則在兩陣之間周旋，試圖以宗主身分換取喘息。身後名聲方面，二十世紀的埃及學者布雷斯特與塞特依卡爾納克與拉美西姆兩份戰役表，把本役排為第二十二年之役、第十次敘利亞遠征；近代考古學者再把敘利亞北部的泰勒卡澤爾土丘同浮雕中的地景對照，提出戰場即在該處的假說。
peopleEn: Thutmose III is the pivotal figure of the whole affair. His royal name carries the sense of the 'strong bull', and he campaigned into the Levant again and again in the years after his accession; this tenth Syrian expedition fell in the twenty-second year of his reign. The victory, the fall of Tunip and the plunder of the town are all carved into the reliefs of the temple of Amun at Karnak. Around the king worked the vizier who handled civil administration and supply, the army scribes who copied out the orders day by day, and the priestly corps of the temple of Amun that performed the rites and prayers before the march; at the head of the charge stood the leader of the Sherden mercenaries and the commander of the pharaoh's brave troops. On the other side, the ruler of Tunip was taken captive on the day the city fell, the kings of Kadesh and Hamath brought up their contingents and then scattered, and the envoys of the Great King of Mitanni, Tushratta, moved between the two camps trying to buy breathing room on his overlordship. As for posterity, Egyptologists of the twentieth century such as Breasted and Sethe read the Karnak list and the Ramesseum tablet and fixed this campaign as the expedition of regnal year 22, the tenth Syrian war; modern archaeology has then set the mound of Tell Kazel in northern Syria against the landscape carved in the relief and proposed it as the battlefield.
kits: 本役的主兵器是埃及長矛：早王朝以來沿用的制式裝備，木杆前端綁上銅或青銅矛頭，杆長約兩米上下，握在手中既能刺穿，也能擋格；新王國的步兵把長矛當作最可靠的近戰手段，密集的矛陣平舉前推，矛尖像一片移動的牆逼近敵陣，攻城時長矛兵更與銅斧、石錘、繩梯一同壓上城牆，是卡爾納克與拉美西姆浮雕中最易辨認的裝備。除長矛外，埃及步兵大量使用複合弓：燼木與角木製成的主體配以羊筋，箭長約六十至七十厘米，銅鏢或骨鏢造成大量箭傷；近身還備有直刃雙鋒銅劍（昔日的月牙劍此時已退為儀仗）、銅斧與石錘，以及手投的鉛錘與投石手。防具是蒙皮包覆的框架盾，兼作小盾與重盾兩種；王侯與近衛配有雙馬輕車。攻城器材以繩梯最關鍵，渡河則靠小艇與臨時架設的浮橋或索道，後方以牛車、驢隊與陶壺運水運糧，商船隊沿海路把穀物運往北方。
kitsEn: The chief weapon of this campaign was the Egyptian spear, a standard piece carried down from the Early Dynastic period: a wooden shaft with a copper or bronze blade lashed to its head, roughly two metres in overall length, held either to thrust or to parry. In the New Kingdom the infantry treated the spear as its most dependable close-combat arm; a dense body of spears was levelled and advanced like a moving wall, and at the walls of a city spearmen pressed forward together with bronze axes, stone maces, ropes and ladders — the easiest gear of all to identify in the reliefs of Karnak and the Ramesseum. Alongside the spear the Egyptian infantry made heavy use of the composite bow, its core of ebony and horn reinforced with sinew, with arrows some sixty to seventy centimetres long tipped with bronze or bone points; at close quarters they carried straight-bladed double-edged bronze swords (the old crescent khopesh had by then become parade furniture), bronze axes and stone maces, and they also used hand-thrown lead weights and slingers. Their protection was a hide-covered frame shield used in more than one size, and princes and bodyguard officers had light two-horse chariots. Siege work turned chiefly on rope ladders; rivers were crossed in small boats or on improvised bridges and rope lines, and behind the army came ox-carts, donkey trains and pottery water jars, while merchant ships carried grain north by sea.
tactics: 遠征自埃及出發，走的是沿地中海東岸北上、再折入內陸的軍用大道：穿過西奈與迦南，經利萬河谷抵達阿姆魯魯一帶，再由奧龍特斯河向東進入幼發拉底河的上游地帶。為避開炎熱與缺水，遠征安排在旱季，並在關口與綠洲驛站預備水井與牲畜，穀物同時由海路船隊北運，減少陸隊的負擔。接戰前，埃及軍以師團布陣：阿蒙師居中或壓向右翼，賴師、塞特師等分列兩翼，弓箭手在前列放箭掩護，矛兵在後列成密陣，車隊隨法老待機；一旦敵軍前壓，矛陣即以整齊的推進線向前移動，車兵則趁隙插入追擊。卡爾納克浮雕留下的攻城程序最具體：先以小艇與浮橋渡過城前的河川，再沿城壕接近，把繩梯架上城頭，長矛兵與斧手同時攀城；城破之後，士兵縱火燒毀城外的橄欖園與莊稼，並把擄獲的牲畜與車輛運回營地。追擊與清剿則在城外開闊地進行，聯軍殘部多沿河谷向上游逃竄。
tacticsEn: The expedition set out from Egypt along the military road that runs north along the Mediterranean shore and then turns inland: across Sinai and Canaan, up the valley of the Leonte, and then east from the Orontes into the upper country of the Euphrates. To avoid the worst heat and the shortage of water the campaign was timed for the dry season, wells and cattle were held ready at the frontier posts and the oasis stations, and grain was also shipped north by sea so as to lighten what the land column had to carry. Before contact the Egyptian host was drawn up in divisions: the Division of Amun in the centre or pressing on the right, the Divisions of Re and Seth on the wings, archers in front to loose their arrows, spearmen massed in close order behind, and the chariots waiting with the king. Once the enemy pressed forward the spear line advanced in a single unbroken movement, and the chariots slipped through the gap to pursue. The assault on the city is the best preserved part of the procedure, for the Karnak relief shows it step by step: the river in front of the town was crossed in boats and on a makeshift bridge, the walls were approached along the ditch, ladders were set against the ramparts, and spearmen and axe-men climbed together. After the city fell the soldiers fired the olive groves and standing crops outside the walls and carried the seized cattle and vehicles back to camp. The pursuit and the mopping-up were fought in the open ground beyond the town, where the broken coalition fled north and upstream along the river valleys.
data: 可用的數字不多，卻能框出本役的規模。圖特摩斯三世登基年代有高、中、低三種年表，通行的高年表把他的在位期放在公元前一四七九至一四二五年，第十次敘利亞遠征落在第二十二年，即約公元前一四四四年；即使採較晚的年表，本役仍在公元前一四五〇年前後。卡爾納克與拉美西姆兩份戰役表合起來記錄了這位法老在敘利亞的十數次出征，本役在表中排第十，但第十與第十一次之間的對應關係仍有學界爭議。戰役表提到本役奪取圖尼普，並以「數千頭牛羊、數百匹馬」這樣的量級記錄掠得物資，卻不給總數；埃及軍的實際投入人數沒有可靠記載，只能依新王國師團編制推測，一個滿編師團約五千人，十個師團合計可達數萬。卡爾納克戰役表為部分遠征保留了月份，本役的標記殘缺，只能確定落在旱季（埃及曆沙姆烏，約西曆四月至六月），故本卡以四月作為遠征展開的月份。地理上，從尼羅河三角洲到圖尼普所在的幼發拉底中游，陸路約九百至一千公里；戰場一側的泰勒卡澤爾土丘位於敘利亞北部貝利赫河谷，在拉斯阿因以南約十公里、離幼發拉底河不遠，考古發掘目前只覆蓋土丘的一小部分。武器尺寸方面，埃及長矛的杆長約兩米上下，箭長約六十至七十厘米，複合弓的有效射程約八十至一百米；從出發到回師，整場遠征大致要耗上一個旱季。
dataEn: The usable figures are few, but they do fix the scale of the campaign. Thutmose III's accession has been placed by high, middle and low chronologies, the high chronology putting his reign between 1479 and 1425 BC, and this tenth Syrian expedition falls in regnal year 22, that is about 1444 BC; even on the later chronologies the campaign still falls shortly before 1450 BC. Taken together the Karnak list and the Ramesseum tablet record a dozen or more of this king's expeditions into Syria, and this one is the tenth in the list, though the exact correspondence between the tenth and the eleventh entries remains disputed. The list notes the taking of Tunip and records the spoils in bulk — thousands of cattle and sheep, hundreds of horses — without giving totals; the actual number of Egyptian troops deployed is not preserved and can only be estimated from the New Kingdom divisional system, a full division running to about five thousand men and ten divisions therefore amounting to tens of thousands. The Karnak list preserves a month for several of the expeditions, but the entry for this one is broken and can only be fixed to the dry season, the Egyptian season of Shemu, roughly the fourth to the sixth month of the year, so this card takes April as the month in which the expedition opened. Geographically the land march from the Nile Delta to Tunip on the middle Euphrates is something like nine hundred to a thousand kilometres, and the mound of Tell Kazel, on the Balikh valley in northern Syria about ten kilometres south of Ras al-Ayn and not far from the Euphrates, has so far been excavated only in small part. As for the arms themselves, the Egyptian spear shaft stands at around two metres, the arrow at sixty to seventy centimetres, and the effective range of the composite bow at roughly eighty to a hundred metres; and the round trip, from departure to the return of the army, would have filled a good part of one dry season.
cause: 打起來的原因在埃及的邊境檔案裡說得最清楚。胡里王國米坦尼在黎凡特擴張，把阿勒頗、卡疊施等原屬埃及附庸的城邦收編，截斷了從比羅霍寧到敘利亞的商路與朝貢線，埃及在迦南的進貢因此大減，關塞與前線堡壘屢受襲擊。圖特摩斯三世登基後每年在北部邊界城市佩爾-傑德哈塞主持「出巡」與慶典，維持埃及在黎凡特的邊界存在；第二十二年前後，聯盟重整，圖尼普等城加入對抗，埃及的守土將領連年請援，國王遂再啟遠征。就更深一層看，這不是單純的報復，而是維持「兩地平衡」——北方邊界必須由國王本人與大軍在場才能成立；同時，卡爾納克的浮雕與戰役表也需要新的戰功，來鞏固法老的威權與阿蒙神廟的聲望。
causeEn: The reasons are set out most clearly in the Egyptian frontier records. The Hurrian kingdom of Mitanni had pushed into the Levant, taking over city-states such as Aleppo and Kadesh that had previously been Egyptian tributaries, and so it cut the trade route and the line of tribute that ran from Byblos to Syria; Egypt's tribute from Canaan shrank accordingly, and the frontier posts and forts there were repeatedly attacked. After his accession Thutmose III held his 'going forth' and the border festival every year at Per-Djedkhase in the northern border city, and the mere presence of the king and his court kept Egypt's claim to the land of Retjenu alive. In and around regnal year 22 the coalition was reorganised, towns such as Tunip joined the resistance, and the Egyptian governors of the border called for help year after year, until the king marched out again. At a deeper level this was not revenge but the maintenance of the 'balance of the Two Lands': the northern frontier existed only when the king and a great army were present in it. At the same time the reliefs of Karnak and the campaign lists needed fresh deeds of arms to sustain the authority of the pharaoh and the standing of the temple of Amun.
impact: 本役的直接影響，是把埃及的北界重新推到幼發拉底河中游，並讓圖尼普一度回到埃及一方。但埃及沒有佔領這座城，也沒有能力常駐河谷；真正的成果是一種「看得到的力量」：聯盟首領知道遠征可以再來，便不敢輕易脫離。從更長的視角看，第十次敘利亞戰役延續了圖特摩斯三世建立的新秩序——北敘利亞的城邦在米坦尼與埃及之間反覆易手，此後數十年直到阿卡德王朝前期與赫梯崛起之前，沒有一方能獨吞這片走廊。在文化與政治記憶上，卡爾納克的攻城浮雕與拉美西姆的戰役表成為古埃及「書寫戰爭」的樣本，後來拉美西姆二世在附近的阿蒙神廟重新雕刻與改刻前代王的戰績，把自己的戰爭接在同一面牆上；今日學者正是靠這兩份表，把這位法老的二十年遠征排成可比的次序，而泰勒卡澤爾假說則示範了把銘文與地形互相對照的方法。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the campaign was to push Egypt's northern frontier back to the middle Euphrates and to bring Tunip once more to the Egyptian side. Egypt did not occupy the city, nor could it garrison the river valley permanently; the real result was a visible presence, for the leaders of the coalition knew that the expedition could come again and so could not lightly slip away. From a longer view the tenth Syrian war carried forward the new order built by Thutmose III: the city-states of northern Syria changed hands repeatedly between Mitanni and Egypt, and for the decades that followed — through the early Old Babylonian period and up to the rise of the Hittites — neither side was able to swallow the corridor whole. In cultural and political memory the siege relief at Karnak and the Ramesseum list became specimens of Egyptian 'writing of war', and Ramesses II later recut and restated his predecessor's deeds on the nearby walls of the temple of Amun, grafting his own campaigns onto the same surface; today it is precisely from these two lists that scholars set out this king's two decades of campaigning in an order that can be compared, while the Tell Kazel hypothesis demonstrates how an inscription may be checked against the ground.
result: 結果是埃及得勝而聯盟瓦解。圖尼普在圍城之後陷落，城市遭到劫掠，聯軍在野外的聯隊被擊散，數以百計的牲畜、馬匹與工匠被帶回埃及，戰役表把這些收穫記在第二十二年的名下。圖特摩斯三世隨即回師，並沒有在圖尼普留下常駐守軍，只在原有的邊境據點與關口保留駐軍，維持對河谷的「存在」。對聯盟首領而言，這是一個重創但不是終局：卡疊施與哈馬圖一系的諸王在其後一兩次敘利亞遠征中再起，翌年的卡疊施會戰更把戰線推回奧龍特斯河谷。本役於是成為圖特摩斯三世連續二十餘年北方戰爭中的一環：它沒有終結敘利亞問題，卻確定了往後每一次遠征的規則——先入黎凡特，再據關口，最後打到能俯瞰幼發拉底河的地方。
resultEn: The outcome was an Egyptian victory and the break-up of the coalition. Tunip fell after its siege, the town was plundered, the allied contingents were scattered in the open, and hundreds of cattle, horses and craftsmen were carried back to Egypt, the booty being entered under regnal year 22. Thutmose III then marched home and left no permanent garrison in Tunip, keeping troops only at the existing frontier posts and passes so as to preserve his 'presence' over the valley. For the leaders of the coalition this was a blow but not an end: the kings of the Kadesh and Hamath lines rose again in the next campaign or two, and the campaign of Kadesh in the following year pushed the line of contact back into the valley of the Orontes. The tenth Syrian war thus stands as one link in a chain of more than twenty years of northern warfare: it settled nothing permanent in Syria, but it fixed the rules of every later expedition — first into the Levant, then holding the passes, and finally up to the point from which the Euphrates could be overlooked.
